infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Boltzy uses your camera to let you snap and upload photos of items you want to sell directly in the app.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Boltzy accesses your photo library so you can select and upload existing images for your marketplace listings.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Boltzy uses your location to automatically filter the feed and show you items for sale right in your neighborhood.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Boltzy requires access to your contacts so you can quickly and securely share phone numbers within buyer/seller chats.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Boltzy needs microphone access to allow you to search the marketplace hands-free using your voice.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Boltzy uses speech recognition to convert your spoken words into text for the search bar.
